description: For jobsite safety, this issue tracking log records task hazards, competent-person controls, PPE, access protection, emergency contacts, and weather limits. Its supporting evidence includes pre-task briefing record, inspection observations, control photos, permits, and corrective-action verification.

blocks.guidance: Link this jobsite safety record to its evidence.

subtitle: Jobsite Safety Issue Tracking Log: jobsite hazard assessment and control verification using work zone, task hazards, and pre-task briefing record.
title: Jobsite Safety Issue Tracking Log
use_case: Use the issue tracking log during jobsite hazard assessment and control verification when the jobsite safety record must identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces. Complete the applicable handoff for competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
